data.camera: cowboy shot, high-speed ODM flight between giant trees with dual blades drawn
data.description: 【三笠 · 森林立体机动】树海之间，三笠借着立体机动装置从巨树之间疾掠而过，双刀出鞘带起两道寒芒，红围巾在高速中被拉成一条笔直的线——「障碍越多，我只会更快。」
data.promptProse: Mikasa flies between immense forest trunks on her ODM cables, both blades drawn and her red scarf stretched behind by speed. Her Survey Corps uniform and green cape follow the cowboy-shot movement, with a near trunk passing across one side and successive trees receding beyond. Light through canopy gaps catches her blades and cable lines, while broad tree shadows separate the darker corridor of her flight.
data.title: 三笠 · 森林立体机动
